topics.title: Fireplace, chimney exterior and hearth
visual_cues: visible cracking or joint separation at hearth and firebox
stains or evidence of moisture around chimney
deterioration at accessible masonry or vent connections
missing or unverified carbon monoxide alarm where required by applicable SOP and local rules
alternative_explanations: surface discoloration unrelated to active leakage
request_more_evidence: inspect readily accessible surfaces without entering a flue
qualified chimney professional inspection and any necessary test
urgent_triggers: active heat damage or uncontrolled flame hazard
topics.referral: qualified chimney/fireplace professional; emergency response if an immediate life-safety danger is present

topics.title: Garage vehicle doors and opener safety
visual_cues: damaged or frayed visible lift cables
bent tracks or damaged door panels
damaged safety labels or manual release
request_more_evidence: qualified inspector to perform only permitted normal-controls operational checks where safe and within SOP
refer suspected entrapping or broken tensioned components to qualified garage-door technician
urgent_triggers: broken spring or cable presenting imminent mechanical hazard

topics.title: Commercial life-safety systems and specialty assessments
visual_cues: damage to fire door or firestopping
alternative_explanations: temporary condition with documented corrective action
request_more_evidence: review contracted commercial PCA scope and fire department records
obtain approved plans, tests and permits from AHJ
topics.referral: licensed fire-protection engineer, local fire authority and other specialty professionals as appropriate
